szenen.text: Microsoft. Nvidia. And now the banks. Three shocks in one week.
Monday: thousands of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and U.S. Bank customers reported they could not log in or move their money. Over 4,600 outage reports for Chase alone.
Chase calls it a technical issue. Bank of America and U.S. Bank gave no explanation at all.
Last week, Nvidia lost its CEO, and a global Microsoft outage took down Outlook, Teams and Azure.
Our view: the old system is starting to collapse. And a new one is being built. On January 18th, US banks may start issuing their own digital dollars. Coincidence? We don't think so.
